name: Laser Tek Taiwan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Laser Tek Taiwan Co.,Ltd. engages in the processing of surface mounted devices (SMD), surface mount technology (SMT) equipment, enterprise intelligent information systems, and laser precision solutions in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through three segments: SMD Segment, Equipment Segment, and Other Segment. The SMD Segment processes and sells of passive component wafer roll materials; active component plastics; manufacturing, processing and sales of roll materials; electronic components and spare parts related to the SMD industry.
